usedFor: Shopify holds your store customers, and Altoviz receives each one as an invoicing contact through “Create a Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Customer” in Shopify, then “Create a Contact” in Altoviz
bestTemplate.why: A new store customer is already a contact in Altoviz when you need to invoice them.

watchOut: “Create a Contact” adds a contact each run, so check for duplicates if customers already exist in Altoviz.
